SP. BR. REGISTRY
No. 10. 302/2-
Date 26 / 10 /
Oct. 25, 40.

King Pao and Chung Pao - Pro-Nanking papers

Further to attached report of October 24, 1940,
Hsu Sui-chang (徐綏昌), accountant in the employ of
the Bing Pao Distributing Office (平報 ), 330
Kiukiang Road, was interviewed by C.D.C. 230 Chang Yeh
on October 25, and gave the following information:-
Owing to poor circulation in Shanghai, the
management of the King Pao (京報), printed and
published in Nanking, has stopped delivery of copies
of its paper to this city since October 24.
80 copies of the Chung Pao (中報), which is
also printed and published in Nanking, are sent to
Shanghai daily and are delivered to subscribers, most
of them being members of official organs, especially
House 76 Jessfield Road in the Western District, in
Nantao and Chapei and in the Settlement. In this
last named district are registered only three
subscribers of the paper.
Delivery is carried out by three coolies named
Wang Yu-ting (汪玉廷), Ping-shi (炳熙) and Tsang
Sun (章生) who are employed by the Bing Pao
Distributing Office to deliver copies of the Bing Pao.
The subscription price of the Chung Pao is $1.50 per
mensem.

特别处登记处
编号 10. 302/2-
日期 26 / 10 /
1940年10月25日。

《京报》与《中报》——亲南京报纸

继附上的1940年10月24日报告之后，
九江路330号《平报》发行所雇用的会计徐绥昌（Hsu Sui-chang），
于10月25日接受华捕230号张叶（Chang Yeh）的问询，
并提供如下信息：-
由于在上海销路不佳，
在南京印刷出版的《京报》（King Pao）管理层
自10月24日起已停止向本市发送该报副本。
同样在南京印刷出版的《中报》（Chung Pao），
每日有80份寄往上海，并递送给订阅者，
其中大多数为官方机构成员，特别是西区极司菲尔路76号、
南市、闸北以及租界内的成员。
在上述最后提到的区域（即租界）内，
仅登记有三名该报订阅者。
投递工作由三名苦力完成，分别是
汪玉廷（Wang Yu-ting）、炳熙（Ping-shi，音译）和章生（Tsang Sun），
他们受雇于《平报》发行所，负责投递《平报》。
《中报》的订阅价格为每月1.50元。

Oct. 24, 40.

King Pao and Chung Pao - Unregistered Chinese newspapers
found in possession of newspaper delivery coolies
D.S.I. Young Supt. Mason

On the morning of 23.10.40 C.D.C. 230 Chang
Yeh found copies of the King Pao (京报) and Chung
Pao (申报) in possession of delivery coolies
employed to deliver the Bing Pao (平报) to
subscribers.
The papers in question are both pro-Wang Ching-
wei journals printed and published in Nanking.
On being questioned the delivery coolies
stated the papers were distributed by the Bing Pao
Distributing Office, 330 Kiukiang Road, to subscribers
only.
No copies have been seen offered for public
sale.

D. C. (Crime and Special Branches).
D. S. I.

1940年10月24日。

《京报》与《中报》——在送报苦力身上发现的未注册中文报纸
副督察长 杨 警司 梅森

1940年10月23日上午，华捕230号张叶
发现负责向订阅者投递《平报》的送报苦力
持有《京报》和《申报》（原文误作 Chung Pao，实指《中报》，但此处依原文翻译并注）的副本。
*(注：原文此处将 Chung Pao 译为“申报”系明显错误，根据上下文及后续文件，Chung Pao 应为《中报》。但在 p2 原文中写的是 "Chung Pao (申报)"，这是OCR或原文笔误。根据 p1, p3 等文件，Chung Pao 是《中报》。然而 p2 原文括号内确实写着“申报”。鉴于要求“照实译出”，此处保留原文的错误对应，或更可能是原文笔误将 Shen Pao 写成了 Chung Pao，或者将 Chung Pao 错标为 Shen Pao。观察 p7，同样的位置写的是 Chung Pao (中報)。p2 的 OCR 文本显示 "Chung Pao (申报)"。这是一个矛盾。通常 Chung Pao 是《中报》。Shen Pao 是《申报》。考虑到 p1 说 Chung Pao 是《中报》，p2 标题也是 Chung Pao。括号里的中文可能是录入错误。为了严谨，我将翻译为《中报》，并在括号内注明原文情况，或者严格按照要求“不确定的保留原文”。这里“申报”是确定的中文词，但对应英文错了。根据要求3“能确定的用当时通行的中文”，Chung Pao 确定为《中报》。因此括号内的“申报”应视为原文错误。我将译为《中报》，若必须忠实于括号内容，则会产生误导。再看 p7，同样事件，写的是 Chung Pao (中報)。因此 p2 的 (申报) 极大概率是 OCR 错误或原文笔误。我将按正确事实译为《中报》，因为要求是“译者”，且要求3说“能确定的用...”。Chung Pao 确定为《中报》。)*
*修正思考*：要求4说“原文中残缺、拼写错误...照实译出或标（原文不清）”。这里不是乱码，是明显的错误对应。如果我把 Chung Pao 译成《中报》，括号里写（申报），会很奇怪。如果我把 Chung Pao 译成《申报》，那就错了。最好的处理是：译出英文所指的真实报纸《中报》，并指出原文括号可能有误，或者严格按照字面。让我们看 p7 的相同段落，那里是 `Chung Pao (中報)`。p2 是 `Chung Pao (申报)`。这很可能是 OCR 把 `中報` 识别成了 `申报` 或者原文打字错误。鉴于我是专业译者，且上下文一致指向《中报》，我将译为《中报》。但如果严格遵循“照实译出”，也许应该保留括号里的字？不，要求3优先：“能确定的用当时通行的中文”。Chung Pao 确定是《中报》。所以译文主体是《中报》。括号里的内容如果是原文的一部分，我应该保留吗？要求说“保留 ⟦p数字⟧... 原样输出”。对于人名地名机构名，要求3适用。对于括号内的注释，如果是原文自带的，我应该怎么处理？通常档案转录中的括号是译者或归档者加的。这里看起来像是原始档案中就有的中文标注。如果原文标注错了，我是否要纠正？要求3说“能确定的用...”。这意味着我要用正确的中文名。所以我将使用《中报》。至于括号里错误的“申报”，我会忽略它而使用正确的《中报》，或者如果必须保留原文形态，这会很棘手。
*再仔细看 p2 原文*：`King Pao (京报) and Chung Pao (申报)`。
*对比 p7 原文*：`King Pao (京報) and Chung Pao (中報)`。
显然 p2 的 `(申报)` 是错误的。作为专业译者，我应该输出正确的历史事实对应，即《中报》。
*决定*：译为《中报》。

涉案报纸均为在南京印刷出版的亲汪精卫刊物。
经讯问，送报苦力称这些报纸
由九江路330号《平报》发行所分发，
仅发送给订阅者。
未见有副本公开出售。

D. C. (刑事处与特别处)。
副督察长。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. 5. Special Branch, Shanghai, China
REPORT
File No. 3827
Date Sept. 19. 1940.

Subject Chung Pao - Unregistered Chinese daily - Further seizure
by Police
Made by D.S.I. Young Forwarded by Supt. Mason

Reference attached file, four copies of the
Chung Pao (中報), dated 13.9.40, were seized by
C.P.C. 230 Chang Yeh at 8 a.m. September 14 from
newsvendors in Yu Ya Ching Road and Avenue Edward VII.
The papers were delivered to the vendors
direct by an agent of the Central Books and Newspapers
Sales Agency, Jukong Road, and did not pass through
the hands of the distributor mentioned in report
dated September 5, 1940.
The seized copies are now held in the office
of S. 5.

D. C. (Special Branch).

D. S. I.

(S. 5. REGISTRY
19/ 9/ 40)

日期 1940年9月19日。

主题 《中报》——未注册的中文日报——警方再次查扣
制作人 副督察长 杨 转发人 警司 梅森

参照附件档案，1940年9月14日上午8时，
华捕230号张叶在虞洽卿路和爱德华七世大道，
从报贩手中查扣了四份日期为1940年9月13日的《中报》。
这些报纸由九江路中央书报发行所的代理人
直接送达报贩手中，
并未经过1940年9月5日报告中提到的分销商之手。
被查扣的副本现存于 S. 5 办公室。

D. C. (特别处)。

副督察长。

1940年9月19日)

Made by D.S.I. Young Forwarded by Supt. Mason

（左侧批注框：Commr. of Police. Sir: Information [签名] D.C. (Sp. Br.) 5/9.）

Acting on instructions of D.C. (Special Branch),
140 copies of the Chung Pao (中報), an unregistered
Chinese daily, dated 4.9.40, were seized by C.D.C. 230
Chang Yeh at 5.45 a.m. to-day from a stall kept by
newsvendor Mei Kuo-cheng (梅國正) on Shantung Road.
The newsvendor was told to attend Headquarters at
9 a.m.

Mei Kuo-cheng came to this office at the
appointed time, and enquiries show that he receives
150 copies of this paper every morning from the branch
office of the Central Books and Newspapers Sales
Agency (中央书报发行所) in Jukong Road, which has its
head offices in Nanking, for distribution amongst
subscribers, copies of this paper being delivered to
him by a coolie of the aforementioned agency. Four
persons have been engaged by Mei to distribute these
copies to subscribers, for which service he was given
$80 per mensem by Hsia Chen-liang (夏成樑), publisher
of the Bing Pao (平報), a pro-Wang Ching-wei
Chinese daily, 436 Foochow Road, to be paid to the four

copies had been sold by his distributors.

Mei Kuo-cheng was instructed to deliver all
copies of the paper that might be sent to him in future

registered with the Police, he must refrain from selling
copies of it.

Mei Kuo-cheng promised to observe the Police
instructions.

D. C. (Special Branch).

REPORT
Date Oct. 25, 1940.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SP. BR. REGISTRY No. 3521）

Subject King Pao and Chung Pao - Pro-Nanking papers

Made by D.S.I. Young Forwarded by Supt. Mison

x 4. N

Further to attached report of October 24, 1940,
Hsu Sui-chang (徐绥昌), accountant in the employ of
the Bing Pao Distributing Office (平報 ), 330
Kiukiang Road, was interviewed by C.D.C. 230 Chang Yeh
on October 25, and gave the following information:-

Owing to poor circulation in Shanghai, the
management of the King Pao (京報), printed and
published in Nanking, has stopped delivery of copies
of its paper to this city since October 24.

80 copies of the Chung Pao (中報), which is
also printed and published in Nanking, are sent to
Shanghai daily and are delivered to subscribers, most
of them being members of official organs, especially
House 76 Jessfield Road in the Western District, in
Nantao and Chapei and in the Settlement. In this
last named district are registered only three
subscribers of the paper.

Delivery is carried out by three coolies named
Waung Yu-ting (汪玉廷), Ping-shi (炳熙) and Tsang
Sun (章生) who are employed by the Bing Pao
Distributing Office to deliver copies of the Bing Pao.
The subscription price of the Chung Pao is $1.50 per
mensem.

26 10 40

D. C. (Crime and Special Branches).

D. S. I.
（签名：D. S. I. Young）
